name: beacon
description: Beacon: prefixes the session title with one glyph that says what the session is doing (working, waiting on background work, needs your answer, done), so the desktop sidebar reads at a glance

slowSeconds.title: Slow call threshold (seconds)
slowSeconds.description: A foreground tool call running longer than this turns the glyph from working to waiting

staleMinutes.title: Stale wait threshold (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: A session that ended its turn waiting for background work and has not been woken within this many minutes turns from waiting to error

classify.title: Classify unclear endings with the small model
classify.description: When the heuristics cannot tell whether a long last reply needs your answer, ask the engine's small model (one short completion per turn end). It tends to read a report that mentions a choice as a question.

markUnread.title: Mark a finished turn unread
markUnread.description: When a turn ends, set the session's blue unread dot in the sidebar; the app clears it when you open the session, so the dot marks results you have not looked at yet

debugLog.title: Debug log file
debugLog.description: Absolute path of a file the mod appends its diagnostics to; empty for none
